propositions: AGENTS.md 'Module-size policy' section documents the 800-LOC gate but omits the C901 cyclomatic-complexity shrink-only ratchet (.github/complexity-baseline.json, threshold 15, enforced by scripts/check_complexity_baseline.py during make lint)
The C901 ratchet fails builds when functions gain new complexity debt or exceed per-symbol ceilings, causing predictable failures during routine work like adding CLI flags or guard clauses
Implementers discover the complexity ratchet only at pre-flight CI, forcing unplanned behavior-preserving extraction passes after routine changes pass behavioral and LOC gates
The fix for C901 failures is refactoring via extraction, never baseline bumping, yet this constraint and remedy strategy are not surfaced alongside the module-size limit in agent-facing documentation
